physical_mismatches.reason: The original package is a heterogeneous 3D stack: passive interposer with TSVs, RDL, microbump layer, epoxy fill, C4 pillars and organic substrate. A simple 2D steady-state chiplet model cannot reproduce this vertical structure or its layer-wise conductivities, and the layer properties are inherited from refs [6,36] rather than listed in the packet.

The paper's cooling is an air-forced heatsink with 0.1 K/W convective resistance, spreader and sink edges 2x the interposer, and 45 C ambient (PDF p.3). The pinned hotspot.config instead has r_convec 0.01 K/W, s_spreader 0.03 m, s_sink 0.06 m, ambient 318.15 K, block model type and secondary path off, so the cooling boundary conditions differ and the paper's Tmax cannot be matched numerically.

The original solver is HotSpot 6.0 on a 64x64 grid, plus a fitted analytical compact model that is least accurate at chiplet edges and the interposer boundary (MAE about 1.2 C overall). A different thermal solver will not reproduce the paper's Tmax.

The optimizer (MILP + CGD + legalization + Optuna) and the final Case 3 placement are not available in the packet. Case3.pl is all (0,0), so any placement used here would be a separate illustration, not the paper's.

The paper has no transient behavior, workload time series, runtime controller or reliability model; it uses static worst-case power only. A transient or controller-based Studio run has no paper counterpart.
The packet's pinned Case3 files support the Fig. 5 caption sizes (CPU 9x8 mm, DRAM 9x9 mm) and the 39 mm interposer. The whitespace of 0.6 and total area cannot be cross-checked without a placement.
Final chiplet coordinates are not supplied by the reference files; generated shelf positions illustrate a 2D power snapshot, not the published placement.
